sloka: देवगन्दर्वकान्याभिर्यक्षकन्याभिरेव च ।सार्धं प्रभो रमस्वेह सीतया किं करिष्यसि ।। ५.५८.७७ ।।।।
transliteration: devagandarvakānyābhiryakṣakanyābhireva ca ।sārdhaṁ prabho ramasveha sītayā kiṁ kariṣyasi ।। 5.58.77 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O lord you enjoy with the daughters of gods, gandharvas and even the young ladies of yakshas. Why do you need Sita?'
